Standard: The air vehicle has sufficient pitch control during a landing to maintain pitch attitude and AOA to prevent overrotation (stall and tail strike), to ensure landing dynamics do not exceed landing gear limits, and results in handling qualities no worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the pitch control required during a landing, in and out of ground effect, as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Longitudinal Control Power in Landing paragraph for each combination of air vehicle states, runway conditions, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the pitch control required during a landing as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Longitudinal Control Power in Landing paragraph for each combination of air vehicle states, runway conditions, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the pitch control required during a landing as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Longitudinal Control Power in Landing paragraph for selected combinations of air vehicle states, runway conditions, and environmental conditions.
